additionalPrimarySources.name: TinySOL 6.0
additionalPrimarySources.mapping: 14 instruments; ordinary articulation; chromatic pitch labels; generally pp/mf/ff; exact per-instrument inventory in raw/tinysol-inventory.json
caveats: About 1% digitally resampled and 640/2,913 files retuned (~22%); rates are much higher for some instruments. Prefer uncorrected rows for first-pass anchors.

additionalPrimarySources.name: Versilian Community Sample Library
caveats: Very large; import only source-traceable curated subsets.

additionalPrimarySources.name: VSCO 2 Community Edition
caveats: Very large; curate by instrument/articulation.

additionalPrimarySources.name: NSynth Dataset
caveats: Only 16 kHz; commercial-library source instruments are transformed to fixed 4-second notes. Useful for textures/ML, below Keyboardia’s preferred fidelity for flagship acoustic instruments.

additionalPrimarySources.name: University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples
additionalPrimarySources.license: custom public-domain-equivalent (“downloaded and used for any projects, without restrictions”)
additionalPrimarySources.licenseScope: the University of Iowa MIS recordings; raw-rebundling interpretation is medium confidence because the page does not use an SPDX license
caveats: Not an SPDX license; preserve the retrieved evidence snapshot and obtain explicit raw-sampler redistribution confirmation or legal review before promotion.

additionalPrimarySources.name: Salamander Grand Piano V3
additionalPrimarySources.revision: Archive.org item SalamanderGrandPianoV3; GitHub SFZ revision 3382bf9496bba2486f5ab0de55a264d1dfc38404
additionalPrimarySources.mapping: 88-key mapping, 16 velocity layers sampled in minor thirds; release and resonance layers
caveats: Full source is large; a curated web subset must preserve velocity relationships and attribution.

additionalPrimarySources.name: Greg Sullivan E-Pianos
additionalPrimarySources.licenseScope: samples and control files as stated in repository LICENSE
additionalPrimarySources.mapping: CP80: 23 roots/up to 4 layers; Wurlitzer EP200: 20 roots/up to 4 layers; Pianet T: 18 roots/up to 2 layers

additionalPrimarySources.name: Discord GM Killer Bass subset
additionalPrimarySources.license: CC0-1.0 declaration in the instrument SFZ
additionalPrimarySources.licenseScope: 45 Killer Bass WAV files referenced by the pinned instrument SFZ comment; not repository-wide; underlying-authority evidence is incomplete
additionalPrimarySources.mapping: 9 roots from MIDI 24–69, five velocity layers each
caveats: Do not treat the Discord GM bank as uniformly licensed. Preserve the pinned SFZ, exact 45-file list, “Killer Bass by Karoryfer” creator statement, and evidence that the declarant controlled the WAV rights before promotion.

additionalPrimarySources.name: Euterpea Studio Harmonium
additionalPrimarySources.licenseScope: underlying Freesound recording 330410 and repository preset
additionalPrimarySources.mapping: 42 chromatic roots C1–F4, neighboring-note round-robin groups, three drones
caveats: Preserve both repository CC0 and the pinned Freesound CC0 evidence.

additionalPrimarySources.name: PublicSamples Modular Hits
additionalPrimarySources.licenseScope: repository content and 474 checked-in audio files
caveats: Unmapped one-shots; audition and curate.

additionalPrimarySources.name: PublicSamples Synth Hits
additionalPrimarySources.licenseScope: repository content and 1,659 checked-in audio files
caveats: Unmapped one-shots from named hardware; audition and curate.

additionalPrimarySources.name: Supercontinent CC0 sample bank
caveats: Mostly ensemble electronic pads, glitches, and effects rather than conventional instruments; unmapped.

additionalPrimarySources.name: Downloaded FreePats evaluation archives
additionalPrimarySources.licenseScope: eight named release archives; see primary instrument pages and embedded license files

explicitRejections.name: OrchideaSOL audio
explicitRejections.reason: Zenodo CC-BY-4.0 covers metadata only; audio is under the restrictive IRCAM Forum license.

explicitRejections.name: Drum and Percussion Kits / SampleSwap derivative
explicitRejections.reason: Record says CC-BY-4.0 but most sounds are filtered from SampleSwap; no per-sample provenance/license chain.

explicitRejections.name: Philharmonia Sound Samples
explicitRejections.reason: Primary page expressly forbids making samples available “as is” or as a sampler instrument.

explicitRejections.name: jRhodes3c / jRhodes3d audio (including current Keyboardia rhodes-ep source)
explicitRejections.reason: Raw sample redistribution is CC BY-NC (and jRhodes3c also SA); CC0 applies only to control files, examples, and music made with the instrument. Current rhodes-ep assets must be quarantined/replaced.

explicitRejections.name: GTownChurchSampling
explicitRejections.reason: Repository terms prohibit commercial redistribution of the instrument/sample content.

explicitRejections.name: Project16
explicitRejections.reason: Custom license forbids distribution of sounds by themselves or as part of another sound library.

explicitRejections.name: Starbirth Kudu Shofar
explicitRejections.reason: Custom terms forbid selling samples or including them in a sample compilation.

explicitRejections.name: CanThaiLinh Casio CTK-660L
explicitRejections.reason: Root CC-BY-4.0 conflicts with README requests not to implement the samples in personal soundfonts; fail closed on contradictory scope.

explicitRejections.name: Bigga Giggas / John Rekevics sax SFZPack
explicitRejections.reason: Repository contains CC0 mappings only; original GIG audio is absent and its redistribution license is not evidenced.

explicitRejections.name: The Metal Kick Drum SFZ mappings
explicitRejections.reason: Unlicense applies to mappings; external audio is absent and not covered.

explicitRejections.name: PublicSamples Drones
explicitRejections.reason: Large raw audio payload but no repository license file or explicit redistribution grant.

explicitRejections.name: PublicSamples Single Cycle Waveforms
explicitRejections.reason: No license file and some waveforms are adapted from old synth recordings without file-level provenance.

explicitRejections.name: Hadzi-Fia / legato vocal tutorial audio
explicitRejections.reason: Root is CC0, but repository includes 517 files from a library now sold commercially; creator authorization for this raw subset should be confirmed before bundling.

explicitRejections.name: Discord GM bank as a whole
explicitRejections.reason: No repository-wide audio license; policy requires instrument-specific evidence. Only individually evidenced subsets may pass.

explicitRejections.name: Splendid Grand Piano
explicitRejections.reason: Repository asserts an old AKAI public-domain release but provides no primary AKAI license evidence; hold under primary-source-only policy.

explicitRejections.name: Maestro Concert Grand
explicitRejections.reason: Copyright notice only; no raw redistribution grant.

explicitRejections.name: Sonatina Symphonic Orchestra
explicitRejections.reason: Creative Commons Sampling Plus is not raw-redistribution-equivalent and forbids offering the work by itself.

explicitRejections.name: Pianobook, Spitfire LABS, commercial/freeware sample packs
explicitRejections.reason: Terms permit music production, not raw sample rebundling; proprietary/custom terms are outside the allowlist.

explicitRejections.name: Freesound as a whole
explicitRejections.reason: Mixed file-level licenses; no blanket library clearance. Individual CC0/CC-BY files can be considered only with pinned file evidence.

explicitRejections.name: GeneralUser GS / mixed General MIDI banks
explicitRejections.reason: Custom or mixed source terms and instrument-level provenance do not establish a single CC0/CC-BY audio scope.

explicitRejections.name: foodforfaeries Ambience-SFX-Free
explicitRejections.reason: CC0 file conflicts with a credit condition and audio was rendered from proprietary Pigments presets without a documented raw-sample redistribution chain.

explicitRejections.name: plopgrizzly/plopsnd
explicitRejections.reason: Public-domain claim but individual gathered recordings lack creator/source provenance; hold rather than trust aggregate assertion.
